Ms. Priscah Muthoni Keah
Head Of Human Resources

Over 10 years
experience in Human
Resource Management.
Prior to joining
Sasini Ltd, she held
various Senior Human
Resources Management
positions in Agribusiness
and Manufacturing
Industries.
Holds Masters
of Business
Administration (MBA)
in Human Resources
Management, Bachelor
of Science (BSc.)
(Mathematics) (Hons),
Post Graduate Diploma
in Human Resources
Management and is a
Member of the Institute
of Human Resources
Management (IHRM).
Appointed Head of
Human Resources in
July 2010.
